# voice — Acme

A written voice, so the fixture stream may draft (`memory.may_draft` asks for
a confirmed owner and this file). Written 2026-11-05 as a fixture.

## voice summary

Plain, declarative, period-separated. Hooks of six to seventeen words. No
emoji, no question as an X hook, no hashtag in the hook line.

## vocabulary

**do use:** root, credential, governance, standard, set.

**don't use:** hype, any claim ahead of delivery.
